user.title: Digitraffic Live
user.description: Live ships, trains and road traffic data from Fintraffic's Digitraffic, as map feeds. Once this is set up, add feeds from the integration page.

data_description.language: Language of the texts written into feeds, such as ship types and popup rows.
Language of the texts written into feeds, such as ship types and popup rows.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Digitraffic Live is already set up. Add more feeds from the integration page.

user.title: Ship feed
user.description: Ships whose AIS position is inside the area. Most small leisure boats don't send AIS.

data_description.name: Also the name of the feed's sensor.
data_description.icebreakers: Uses winter navigation data. Icebreakers are shown whatever the other filters say.
data_description.max_age_minutes: Ships whose latest position is older than this are left out.

reconfigure.title: Ship feed
reconfigure.description: Ships whose AIS position is inside the area. Most small leisure boats don't send AIS.

data_description.max_age_minutes: Ships whose latest position is older than this are left out.

error.area_radius: Drag the circle's edge on the map to set a radius.

user.title: Train feed
user.description: Running trains with a GPS position. Limit the feed with route stations, an area, or both.

data_description.name: Also the name of the feed's sensor.
data_description.route: Only trains that stop at every chosen station, e.g. Helsinki and Lappeenranta.
data_description.area: Used only when "Limit to an area" is on.
data_description.max_age_minutes: Trains whose latest position is older than this are left out.

reconfigure.title: Train feed
reconfigure.description: Running trains with a GPS position. Limit the feed with route stations, an area, or both.

data_description.name: Also the name of the feed's sensor.
data_description.route: Only trains that stop at every chosen station, e.g. Helsinki and Lappeenranta.
data_description.area: Used only when "Limit to an area" is on.
data_description.max_age_minutes: Trains whose latest position is older than this are left out.

error.route_too_short: Choose at least two route stations, or none.
error.route_or_area: Choose route stations, turn on "Limit to an area", or both.
error.area_radius: Drag the circle's edge on the map to set a radius.

abort.cannot_connect: The station list couldn't be loaded from Digitraffic. Try again in a moment.

user.title: Road maintenance feed
user.description: Maintenance vehicles such as snow ploughs and gritters on state roads in the area, and where they have worked. Most city streets are not included.

data_description.route_hours: Hours, at most 24. Used only when routes are shown.

data_description.only_poor: Leave out sections with normal driving conditions.
